items.description: Compensation for items taken in robbery (watch and cash)
items.rationale: The watch and cash were taken by force (2.3.1), reported to the police (2.3.3), and both are insured property (4.2.2 valuables, 4.2.3 cash) carried away from home (4.2.4). The watch is subject to the EUR 2,500 per-item valuables sub-limit and the cash to the EUR 500 cash sub-limit, both per event (schedule, 4.2.2, 4.2.3, 6.3, 7.1.1, 7.5). The watch was bought for EUR 6,000 eight years ago, so current value likely below replacement value (6.2.2), but the sub-limit applies regardless. The total indemnity is EUR 2,500 (watch) + EUR 500 (cash) = EUR 3,000 gross, as in reference case 45.

items.description: Translation and handling of police report for the claim
items.rationale: Translation and handling of documents for the claim are expressly excluded (3.1.6, 7.1.8(f)), even if necessary for substantiating the loss. Reference case 45 confirms t = 0 for translation and claim-processing lines.
